description: Readable pre-dispatch instruction; observed file read can be audited despite encrypted inter-agent transport.
instruction: You are director, an independent professional participant. Read only your packet in permitted_reads. Follow protocol-v2 and its explicit knowledge gate. Open with your own interpretation, relevant private evidence, one consequential proposal and a question to your core colleague. Do not presume agreement, invent colleague speech, use outside facts as established knowledge, or inspect other files. Write an exclusive public JSON response matching response_contract at experiments/competency-live/2026-11-04/benefits/responses/director-01.json, message_id benefits-director-01. Claims must use exact competency strings and allowed standing. Return the same natural professional speech. You may request the listed optional expert for a specific question; no expert may be impersonated.
